title: Counter-USV Adversarial Robustness — derived data & results
description: Weight-free derived annotations, track/behavior/defense features, evaluation freezes, and paper figures for the Counter-USV adversarial robustness project. Companion to the GitHub code repository. Model weights and patch-bank tensors are withheld (dual-use).
